text:
maria: quick sync - we keep tearing down client requests on transient upstream failures and clients hedge immediately. result: two model runs and inflated cost. want to propose a middle state instead of immediate teardown.

sam: +1. observed on the multimodal fleet during snapshots. a 200ms hiccup causes downstream retries.

leo: what does the middle state look like? a backoff? holding the client connection?

maria: not holding the TCP socket. hold the request in a small local queue on the edge (a quarantine). client sees a small, deterministic delay or a probe-response explaining what's happening.

ash: problem: streaming responses - we can't buffer token streams. quarantine only makes sense before first chunk is emitted.

maria: agreed. define "emission boundary". requests are eligible if no token/frame sent yet. once output starts we must proxy through.

ryan: operational plan: edge performs a fast liveness probe to upstream: `HEAD /_quarantine_probe` with jittered backoff (50ms, 120ms, 250ms) up to route-configured window. if upstream recovers, resume.

sam: need explicit policy flags per route: enabled, window_ms, local_limit, fallback_route. otherwise this will surprise customers.

leo: fallback_route should be opt-in. some prompts can't be degraded. also we need idempotency safeguards so we don't charge twice for the same logical request.

maria: propose wire flags: `X-RW-Safepoint: pre-output` (eligibility), `X-RW-Idempotency-Key`, and `X-RW-Quarantine: policy=<drop|fallback|hedge>` to express customer intent.

ash: also add tracing events: `rq.quarantine.start`, `rq.quarantine.probe_attempt`, `rq.quarantine.fallback_used`, `rq.quarantine.abort_client_cancel`. these feed billing reconciliation.

ops-bot: alert: billing team flagged a spike in duplicate-run reconciliations last week, correlates with short GC pauses.

ryan: capacity safety: cap quarantined requests locally per instance (default 16), and per-tenant (default 150). emit metrics and an alarm when per-instance queue > 80% for 1 minute.

sam: what about cross-AZ behavior? must keep quarantine local to preserve KV cache locality; don't ship to other zones.

maria: yes. quarantine is local-only. failing that, fall back to immediate hedged call (if policy allows) or return an explicit transient error.

leo: one more edge case: client disconnect while quarantined. we should abort pre-backend run entirely and mark as `client_cancelled_preoutput` so billing doesn't count.

maria: agreed. i'll draft a succinct RFC appendix: state machine (pre-output -> quarantined -> probe->commit|fallback|abort), header semantics, default numbers, and telemetry labels. cc @ryan for probe impl and @sam for route flags.

ryan: will prototype a local queue + probe library and push a small integration test simulating GC blips.

sam: i'll add route config fields in the console UI mock and ping infra for quota knobs.

ops-bot: guidance: add RFC to `architecture/ingress-quarantine-patterns` and include a short checklist for billing reconciliation. :white_check_mark:

maria: thanks all. filing RFC draft now and will link the prototype PR when ready.
